posts.title: Voyah Passion S goes on sale from about $33,000 to take on Xiaomi YU7
posts.summary:
The Voyah Passion S has limited-time prices of 223,900 yuan ($33,000) to 273,900 yuan, undercutting the Xiaomi YU7.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Dongfeng Motor's Voyah brand has launched the Passion S SUV with a limited-time starting price of 223,900 yuan ($33,000), directly challenging the Xiaomi YU7 in the mid-to-large electric SUV segment.

The vehicle features Huawei's Qiankun ADS 5 advanced assisted driving system and four LiDAR units as standard equipment across all trim levels, signaling a competitive push to commoditize high-end autonomous features.
The top-tier Ultra+ model offers a combined power output of 475 kW and utilizes an 800-volt 5C fast-charging architecture, enabling a 20% to 80% charge in just 10 minutes.
By pricing the Passion S significantly lower than the Xiaomi YU7, Voyah is aggressively targeting younger demographics with a design aesthetic inspired by high-performance luxury utility vehicles.

posts.title: China's NEV sales rise 23.7% in July, with exports surging 1.5 times, CAAM data shows
posts.summary:
NEV sales were 1,561,000 units in July, accounting for 60.4% of total new vehicle sales, topping 60% for the first time, according to CAAM data.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).

China's new energy vehicles (NEVs) accounted for more than 60% of new vehicle sales for the first time in July, as strong export growth offset weak domestic demand.

NEV sales, including domestic deliveries and exports, were 1,561,000 units in July, up 23.7% year-on-year while down 5% from June, according to data released Wednesday by the China Association of Automobile...

posts.title: How the “censorship-industrial complex” is changing the internet and US policy
posts.summary: I first heard the term “censorship-industrial complex” on April 15, 2025.  That’s when I got the tip that a small office in the U.S. State Department, which focused on monitoring and countering foreign disinformation from the likes of Russia, Iran, and China, was facing imminent shutdown—the next day.  And the reason? R/FIMI, as the office…
bullets: The 'censorship-industrial complex' narrative has transitioned from fringe online discourse to a central pillar of the second Trump administration's domestic and foreign policy.
The concept led to the shutdown of the State Department's R/FIMI office, which was previously tasked with countering foreign disinformation from Russia, Iran, and China.
This policy shift carries significant implications for global internet governance, as it challenges the collaborative frameworks between government and tech platforms used to moderate online content.
The narrative is supported by a network of well-funded conservative media and nonprofits, fundamentally altering how information policy is debated and implemented in the US.

posts.title: Ambitious American Science Requires Reliable and Effective Federal Funding
posts.summary: IFP’s comments on OMB’s proposed rule on Federal Financial Assistance
bullets: The OMB has proposed a rule granting the government authority to terminate discretionary grants at any time and requiring political appointees to conduct pre-issuance reviews for all awards.

Critics argue that these changes will destabilize federal funding, as the threat of arbitrary termination undermines the long-term planning necessary for critical sectors like energy, infrastructure, and R&D.
Mandating political oversight over expert merit reviews threatens to degrade the quality of scientific research by prioritizing political alignment over technical feasibility.
The proposed rule risks increasing the administrative burden on grantees and reducing the overall credibility of federal financial assistance programs.

posts.title: What Are DDR5 DIMM Chipsets? The Complete Guide To RCDs, PMICs, SPD Hubs and More
posts.summary:
How DDR5 DIMM chipsets work, why they matter, how they build upon DDR5 technology, and how emerging module architectures are extending memory bandwidth.
The post What Are DDR5 DIMM Chipsets? The Complete Guide To RCDs, PMICs, SPD Hubs and More appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: DDR5 server memory performance now relies on a specialized chipset including Registering Clock Drivers (RCDs), Power Management ICs (PMICs), and SPD Hubs.
These components are essential for scaling bandwidth, capacity, and power efficiency in data-intensive AI and cloud computing environments.
The integration of these chipsets allows for improved signal integrity and thermal management, which are critical for the reliability of modern high-density server platforms.
